Risk officer call: **refuse. Do not buy.**

The brief shows a coin already down 96% from its 30-minute high and 82% over 30 minutes, with 15-minute net outflow of 23.67 SOL and sellers outnumbering buyers 34 to 14. Sell-to-buy ratio at graduation was 0.60, and the curve shows 64% bundle share, 24% top-3 concentration, and a launch bot present. That is a dump pattern, not a dip with a floor.

No ticket size is sane here. Pool depth of 36 SOL means a $20 round trip faces the high end of the 1.4-5.1% cost band, and the trend gives no entry worth a 20-50% stop. Refusal conditions: any sign of renewed net buying with buyer count rising, or a verified operator backing that changes the bundle read. Neither is present.

The early numbers look like a launch-driven pump rather than organic demand: 143 buyers in the first two minutes after graduation with a launch bot present, the top 5 buyers holding 36% of that flow, and a bundle share of 64% on the curve. Sells already run at 60% of buys in that window. Concentration is also high, with the top 3 holders controlling 24% of the curve.

A $20 ticket into a 96% drawdown with active distribution has a poor expected value even after accounting for the chance of a bounce. Skip it.
